remarks:
Looking in Lackawanna? Look no further!

Welcome to 73 Holbrook, a charming two-story home built in 1999 featuring 3 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, a detached one-car garage, and plenty more to love.

The first floor offers a generously sized living room highlighted by an oversized front window that fills the space with wonderful natural light. The living room flows into the dining room, creating a comfortable layout that’s perfect for entertaining. The kitchen features an eat-in area with the potential to add bar seating, giving you the opportunity to make the space your own.

If peace of mind is what you’re looking for, 73 Holbrook offers updated major mechanics. The roof and furnace were both replaced in 2025, providing valuable recent updates for the next owner.

Don’t wait to see all that 73 Holbrook has to offer! Showings begin September 29, 2026. Open houses will be held Thursday, October 1st, and Saturday, October 3rd.
